name: theme-unknown-value
why: A brand a NEWER build wrote must survive a round trip. Only its RESOLUTION falls back — dropping the value means an older build silently deletes a newer build's pin, and the user's choice is gone rather than merely unrendered.
divergence: macOS preserves the raw string; Windows' coerceManifest drops any value that is not a known BrandId, so the next write deletes it.
